general_facts: Each accepted decision executes a short fixed number of native control steps; one bounded EEF target per decision.
Targets are rejected before execution if they exceed per_action_translation_limit or per_action_rotation_limit relative to the CURRENT EEF, or reuse a stale request_id (rejections this episode: 2).
Astra commanded only the left arm (grasp, transport, insertion); the right arm stayed at its home pose apart from harness locate observation moves when it was the observer arm.
The charger object position used in the target arithmetic is link6 + R(q) * (tcp_offset_link6_x + charger_offset_in_tcp).
inhand_pose notes a known failure mode: about one frame in eight can be wrong by a half turn of the charger without the report noticing.

summary: Native success at step 239 (limit 400) in batch hv2a TREAT (layout 15). Astra called locate_outlets first, grasped the charger top-down with the left arm, turned the pins down during transport, hovered above outlet index 0 computed from the located outlets and the in-hand estimate, inserted with pure vertical decrements and released. A first descent shifted the charger in the grasp; Astra lifted clear, re-estimated and recentred before seating.
